note: Registered league formats used by scripts/history/accept-season.mjs. Only formats known with certainty are registered; a season outside every registered era (or a competition without eras) is checked by the generic invariants plus, where present, a reviewed season manifest (data/history-review/). A completed league season must match its era exactly; anything else HOLDS.

eras.basis: 18-club double round robin (1991/92 had 20 clubs; not in the ESPN catalog)

mls.basis: Club count and schedule length changed season by season and teams meet some opponents more than once at home: no era registered; uniform league games per team or a reviewed season manifest decides.
